referee_caveats_inferred: v_col is a line-of-sight velocity dispersion among GMCs in a 300 pc aperture; it also includes galactic and merger velocity gradients and projection effects, so it may not be a true collision velocity
A single alpha_CO of 4.36 is used though the reported range is 1.1-6.54 and varies with region; this changes absolute masses and eps_CCC
The 600 pc line-of-sight depth l is an assumed value that scales f_CCC and hence eps_CCC
SFR map resolution (~600 pc) is coarser than the aperture grid (300 pc sides), so neighbouring apertures are not independent
Statistical association does not demonstrate that collisions cause the observed star formation

products_in_archive.value: Calibrated 12 m / 7 m visibilities from EA ARC and TP cube from the observatory

evidence.quote: For both the 12 m and 7 m arrays data, we utilized calibrated visibility data provided by the East Asian ALMA Regional Center. For the Total Power data, we used the image cube provided by the observatory.

missing_for_reproduction: Exact calibrated products (EA ARC) and line-free channel choice for uvcontsub
Image size, phase centre, CLEAN thresholds and feathering parameters
Definition of per-GMC velocity and aperture grid origin
Region masks for the four sub-regions and bin edges for mass bins
No catalogue of GMCs or apertures is stated as released
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 100-300 GB of raw 12 m + 7 m + TP data for a 13-pointing mosaic with ~29 h on source; several GB for the imaging cube
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA data are public and the cloud-finding and aperture recipe is mostly specified with numeric results, but calibration provenance, line-free channels, mask details and region definitions are missing, and the SFR maps depend on several other archives.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The CO(1-0) archival data are public and the GMC identification and aperture/v_col recipe are specified with numbers (1759 GMCs, 876 apertures, v_col 10-150 km/s), so the ALMA-derived core results can be redone, though full SFR comparison needs several other archives.

methods_papers.why: CPROPS cloud identification and property measurement
PHANGS-ALMA imaging pipeline whose deconvolution scheme is followed
CCC-driven star formation model for eps_CCC

companion_papers.why: Same statistical collision velocity - SFR method applied to NGC 1300
Individual high-speed CCCs in the active overlap region of the Antennae
MUSE H-alpha map used for SFR
